parsed.draft_response:
Hi there—thanks for reporting this. Sorry for the trouble onboarding your new analyst.

We’re going to escalate this for investigation, since other users can access normally but she receives an “access denied” message after accepting the invite.

To help us resolve it as quickly as possible, could you please reply with:
1) The workspace name (or workspace ID) and the analyst’s email address that was invited
2) The exact “access denied” text and any error code (if shown)
3) A screenshot or copy/paste of the message (optional but helpful)
4) Whether she can access any other workspaces, or only cannot access this one

Once we have that, we’ll take a closer look at the invite/access details and work to restore her access today.
promised_actions: Review the workspace/invite access details once the requested information is provided
Work to restore the analyst’s access today
safety_notes: Human review is required; the response does not claim a specific root cause or guarantee restoration.
Does not promise refunds, SLA, or make any security/legal determinations.

parsed.customer_impact: The new analyst cannot access the workspace, blocking onboarding and potentially delaying their ability to perform their job.
grounded_facts: A new analyst was invited yesterday.
After accepting the invite, the analyst gets an 'access denied' message.
Other users can log in normally.
The request is to get the analyst into the workspace today.
The issue occurred after the analyst accepted the invite.
missing_information: Which workspace and account the analyst is trying to access.
The exact wording of the 'access denied' message (and any error code).
Whether the analyst received any confirmation that the invite was accepted successfully.
Whether the analyst’s role/permissions were set as intended for the workspace.
Whether the analyst’s email/account matches the invited identity (no typo/alias).
Whether the analyst can access any other workspaces or only this one.
Whether this behavior is consistent across different devices/browsers/network locations.
Time of first failure and whether it changed after any retries.
risk_signals: An 'access denied' message after accepting an invite indicates a potential authorization/permission issue affecting access for a specific user.
parsed.summary: After accepting an invite, a newly added analyst receives an 'access denied' message and cannot access the workspace, while other users can log in normally.
